title: NExT-Guard: Training-Free Streaming Safeguard without Token-Level Labels
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a real-time safety safeguard framework (NExT-Guard) using Sparse Autoencoders. While it addresses 'harmful' and 'unethical' content as part of a general safety/moderation task, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or philosophical ethical frameworks.
